item.title: [BM] Fahmi Kata Keputusan WFH Penjawat Awam Ditangguh Selepas Raya — Krisis Sekarang, Tapi Rancangan Boleh Tunggu
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 17 Mac 2026, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil sahkan Kabinet telah semak laporan awal mengenai pelaksanaan kerja dari rumah (WFH) untuk penjawat awam tetapi keputusan muktamad hanya akan dibuat selepas Hari Raya Aidilfitri. Bercakap selepas mesyuarat pasca-Kabinet di Putrajaya, Fahmi kata perkara ini akan dirujuk kepada Majlis Tindakan Ekonomi Negara (MTEN) oleh Ketua Setiausaha Negara, dengan alasan perlunya “penyelarasan rapi” dan “penambahbaikan” sebelum pelaksanaan. Beliau tekankan perkhidmatan barisan hadapan seperti kesihatan dan pendidikan tidak akan terjejas, dan sektor swasta bebas melaksanakan dasar WFH sendiri.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Tangguh Keputusan WFH Ke Selepas Raya — Respons Krisis Minyak Kerajaan: Kaji, Semak, Kemudian Tangguh
item.description:

Category: Politics

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 17 Mac, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil memberitahu wartawan selepas mesyuarat Kabinet bahawa keputusan muktamad mengenai pelaksanaan dasar bekerja dari rumah (WFH) untuk sektor awam hanya akan dibuat selepas cuti Hari Raya Aidilfitri. Fahmi kata menteri-menteri telah menyemak ’laporan awal’ mengenai pengaturan kerja fleksibel tetapi ‘beberapa aspek masih perlu diperhalusi.’ Perkara ini akan dirujuk kepada Majlis Tindakan Ekonomi Negara (MTEN) melalui Ketua Setiausaha Negara untuk keputusan selepas Raya. Cadangan WFH ini mula dibangkitkan sebagai langkah penjimatan sebagai tindak balas kepada krisis minyak akibat konflik AS-Iran di Asia Barat, selepas PM Anwar mengarahkan KSN dan Ketua Pengarah JPA mengkajinya.

item.title: [BM] Johari Kata Perjanjian Dagang 'Batal' — Kemudian Kementeriannya Kata Beliau 'Tersalah Cakap,' Dan Ahli Parlimen PH Sendiri Minta Penjelasan
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada hari Ahad 16 Mac, Menteri Perdagangan Antarabangsa dan Perindustrian Johari Abdul Ghani memberitahu wartawan bahawa Perjanjian Perdagangan Timbal Balik Malaysia-AS kini “batal dan tidak sah” susulan keputusan Mahkamah Agung AS yang membatalkan kuasa tarif Trump — “Ia bukan ditangguhkan. Ia sudah tiada, ia batal dan tidak sah,” katanya. Beberapa jam kemudian, kementeriannya sendiri mengeluarkan pembetulan menyatakan menteri telah “tersalah cakap,” tanpa sebarang penjelasan lanjut. Menjelang Isnin, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil memberitahu wartawan selepas mesyuarat Kabinet bahawa MITI akan “terus berunding” dengan Washington, manakala lapan ahli Parlimen PKR mengeluarkan kenyataan bersama menuntut kerajaan jelaskan status perjanjian itu dan memberi amaran ia “berat sebelah.”

item.title: [BM] Mahkamah Tinggi Putuskan Steven Sim 'Jelas Berat Sebelah' Dalam Pertikaian Elaun Perayaan Bank — 'Juara Pekerja' Yang Berpihak Kepada Bank
item.description:
Said by: Steven Sim Chee Keong, Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development Minister (former HR Minister)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 17 Mac 2026, Mahkamah Tinggi Kuala Lumpur memutuskan bahawa bekas Menteri Sumber Manusia Steven Sim Chee Keong gagal bersikap neutral apabila beliau campur tangan dalam pertikaian perdagangan antara Persatuan Bank Perdagangan Malaya (MCBA) dan Kesatuan Kebangsaan Pekerja Bank (NUBE) mengenai bayaran elaun perayaan Hari Raya 2024. Hakim Aliza Sulaiman mendapati Sim telah bertemu wakil MCBA ketika perkara itu sedang melalui proses pendamaian di Jabatan Perhubungan Perusahaan — selepas itu bank-bank bersetuju membayar hanya setengah bulan bonus berbanding bayaran sebulan penuh yang dituntut kesatuan. Hakim berkata Sim telah ‘menyebelahi pihak persatuan secara tidak wajar’ dan ‘mensubversikan proses berkanun yang direka untuk penyelesaian saksama.’ Sim, kini Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi, dan MCBA telah memfailkan rayuan.

item.title: Fahmi Delays WFH Decision for Civil Servants Until After Hari Raya — The Government That Told You to 'Reduce Energy Usage' Can't Even Decide on Working From Home
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 What Happened

On March 17, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced after a post-Cabinet meeting that the government’s decision on implementing work-from-home for civil servants would be delayed until after Hari Raya Aidilfitri. This came just four days after FMT reported on March 13 that the decision was supposed to be made on Tuesday, March 17. Fahmi said “several aspects still need to be refined” and the matter would go to the National Economic Action Council (MTEN) via the Chief Secretary to the Government. He stressed frontline services like healthcare and education would not be affected.

item.title: Fahmi Kicks WFH Decision to After Hari Raya — Government's Oil Crisis Response Is to Study, Review, Then Delay
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister (Government Spokesperson)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 What Happened

On March 17, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil told reporters after a Cabinet meeting that a final decision on implementing work-from-home (WFH) arrangements for the public sector will only come after the Hari Raya Aidilfitri holidays. Fahmi said ministers had reviewed an ‘initial report’ on flexible working arrangements but that ‘several aspects still need to be refined.’ The matter will be referred to the National Economic Action Council (MTEN) via the Chief Secretary to the Government for a post-Raya decision. This WFH proposal was first floated as an austerity measure in response to the oil crisis triggered by the US-Iran conflict in West Asia, after PM Anwar directed the Chief Secretary and PSD director-general to study it.

item.title: Fahmi Says WFH Decision for Civil Servants Delayed Until After Hari Raya — The Crisis Is Now, But the Plan Can Wait
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 What Happened

On March 17, 2026, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil confirmed that the Cabinet has reviewed an initial report on work-from-home arrangements for public sector employees but will not make a final decision until after Hari Raya Aidilfitri. Speaking after a post-Cabinet meeting in Putrajaya, Fahmi said the matter would be referred to the National Economic Action Council (MTEN) by the Chief Secretary to the Government, citing the need for “proper coordination” and “refinement” before implementation. He stressed frontline services like healthcare and education would not be affected, and noted the private sector is free to implement its own WFH policies.

item.title: High Court Rules Steven Sim Was 'Clearly Biased' in Bank Festive Aid Dispute — The 'Workers' Champion' Sided With the Banks
item.description:
Said by: Steven Sim Chee Keong, Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development Minister (former HR Minister)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-17

📌 What Happened

On March 17, 2026, the Kuala Lumpur High Court ruled that former Human Resources Minister Steven Sim Chee Keong failed to maintain neutrality when he intervened in a trade dispute between the Malayan Commercial Banks’ Association (MCBA) and the National Union of Bank Employees (NUBE) over 2024 Hari Raya festive aid payments. Justice Aliza Sulaiman found that Sim had met with MCBA representatives while the matter was undergoing conciliation at the Industrial Relations Department — after which the banks agreed to pay only a half-month bonus instead of the one-month payment the union had demanded. The judge said Sim had ‘improperly aligned his office with the association’ and ‘subverted the statutory process designed for impartial resolution.’ Sim, now Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development Minister, and the MCBA have filed an appeal.

item.title: Johari Says Trade Deal 'Null and Void' — Then His Own Ministry Says He 'Misspoke,' and PH's Own MPs Demand Answers
item.description:
Said by: Johari Abdul Ghani, Investment, Trade and Industry Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-17

It is no longer there, it’s null and void,” he said. Hours later, his own ministry issued a correction stating the minister had “misspoken,” without further explanation. By Monday, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil told reporters after Cabinet that MITI would “continue engaging” Washington, while eight PKR backbenchers issued a joint statement demanding the government clarify the deal’s status and warning the agreement was “one-sided.”

item.title: [BM] Anwar Gelar Tindakan AS-Israel 'Neo-Imperialis' dan Kata Iran Tidak Boleh Diminta 'Menahan Diri Begitu Sahaja' — Sementara Malaysia Rugi RM2 Bilion Sebulan

item.title: Amir Hamzah Rules Out Stimulus Amid Oil Crisis — Tells Rakyat to 'Reduce Energy Usage' Instead
item.description:
Said by: Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

Finance Minister II Amir Hamzah Azizan told reporters on March 16 that no economic stimulus package will be introduced in response to the West Asia conflict. Speaking after the Malaysia Co-Investment Fund (MyCIF) Engagement Day, he said the government’s approach is to “ensure stability over the short term” and urged citizens and companies to “reduce energy usage.” He added that the government bears RM3.2 billion a month in fuel subsidies — up from RM700 million before the crisis.

item.title: Amir Hamzah Rules Out Stimulus Package Amid Oil Crisis — Government's Plan Is to 'Wait and See'
item.description:
Said by: Amir Hamzah Azizan, Finance Minister II

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

On March 16, Finance Minister II Datuk Seri Amir Hamzah Azizan told reporters after launching the Malaysia Co-Investment Fund engagement day in Kuala Lumpur that the government will not introduce an economic stimulus package despite the escalating West Asia conflict. His reasoning: “We do not yet know whether the crisis in West Asia will continue or not. If it does not continue, I think there is no need to implement something like that.” His stated approach: “Look at the short term and ensure the stability that we have.” He confirmed the government is now spending RM3.2 billion a month on fuel subsidies — RM2 billion on petrol and RM1.2 billion on diesel — and encouraged the public and businesses to “reduce energy use.”

item.title: Anwar Calls US-Israel Actions 'Neo-Imperialistic' and Says Iran Can't Be Asked to 'Simply Contain Themselves' — While Malaysia Bleeds RM2 Billion a Month
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

At the launch of the Mushaf Malaysia MADANI in Putrajaya on March 16, Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim disclosed that he had held a second round of discussions with leaders from Iran, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, the UAE, and Türkiye about the West Asia conflict. He described the US-Israeli strikes on Iran as a “sheer display of arrogance” and “neo-imperialistic design,” and said: “It is difficult to ask them simply to contain themselves.” He confirmed the conflict is costing Malaysia an “additional subsidy of RM2 billion a month” to maintain RON95 prices. He also warned against “irresponsible elements exploiting the case and using it as a political weapon, weaponising it to attack.”

item.title: Hannah Yeoh Says KL's RM33m Road Budget 'Not Enough' — After Three Years as Minister, She Just Noticed
item.description:
Said by: Hannah Yeoh, Minister in the Prime Minister’s Department (Federal Territories)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-16

📌 What Happened

Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac, Menteri Komunikasi Datuk Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan Kabinet telah mengarahkan agensi penguatkuasaan — termasuk polis (PDRM), Suruhanjaya Sekuriti (SC), Suruhanjaya Pencegahan Rasuah Malaysia (SPRM), dan Lembaga Hasil Dalam Negeri (LHDN) — menjalankan “siasatan terperinci” terhadap dakwaan rangkaian “mafia korporat” yang beroperasi dalam SPRM. Arahan ini dibuat beberapa minggu selepas Bloomberg menerbitkan siasatan bertajuk Who’s Watching Malaysia’s Anti-Corruption Watchdog? yang mendakwa pegawai SPRM menekan tokoh korporat dalam kes pengambilalihan syarikat. Yang jelas tidak disebut dalam pengumuman Fahmi: sebarang rujukan kepada Suruhanjaya Siasatan Diraja (RCI), walaupun semakin banyak seruan daripada ahli parlimen — termasuk Teresa Kok dari PH sendiri.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Kata Kabinet Mahu Undang-Undang 3R Lebih Ketat — PH Janji Mansuh Undang-Undang Sekat Kebebasan Bersuara, Kini Tulis Yang Baru
item.description:

Category: Politics

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Menteri Komunikasi dan jurucakap kerajaan Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan bahawa Kabinet telah memutuskan tindakan tegas mesti diambil terhadap isu 3R — kaum, agama, dan raja — termasuk di media sosial. Fahmi berkata kerajaan sedang mempertimbangkan untuk meminda undang-undang sedia ada atau memperkenalkan perundangan baru untuk menutup apa yang disifatkannya sebagai kelemahan yang membenarkan individu tertentu mengabaikan langkah penguatkuasaan.

item.title: [BM] Fahmi Umum Jawatankuasa Khas 'Kaji' Kesan Ekonomi Konflik AS-Iran — Buku Panduan Krisis Kerajaan Adalah Satu Lagi Jawatankuasa
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan pada 11 Mac bahawa sebuah jawatankuasa khas yang diketuai pengerusi Petronas Amir Hamzah dan termasuk Menteri Ekonomi Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir, akan menilai kesan ekonomi konflik AS-Iran terhadap Malaysia ‘secara harian.’ Penemuan jawatankuasa ini akan dibentangkan pada mesyuarat Kabinet khas yang dijadualkan pada Jumaat, 13 Mac. Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim berkata bekalan petroleum Malaysia ‘mencukupi sekurang-kurangnya sehingga Mei 2026,’ walaupun pasaran minyak global bergolak akibat gangguan di Selat Hormuz dan serangan balas antara Iran, AS dan Israel yang bermula pada 28 Februari.

item.title: [BM] Kabinet Akhirnya Bincang Laporan Azam Baki — Serah Keputusan Kepada KSN, Enggan Dedahkan Penemuan
item.description:

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Menteri Komunikasi Fahmi Fadzil mengumumkan bahawa Kabinet telah menerima dan membincangkan penemuan jawatankuasa khas — dipengerusikan oleh Peguam Negara Mohd Dusuki Mokhtar — yang menyiasat kontroversi pegangan saham ketua pesuruhjaya SPRM Azam Baki. Keputusan Kabinet: serahkan kepada Ketua Setiausaha Negara Tan Sri Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar untuk menentukan ’langkah seterusnya.’ Fahmi enggan mendedahkan kandungan laporan. Apabila ditanya secara langsung sama ada Kabinet membincangkan pelanjutan kontrak Azam, Fahmi berkata: ‘Ia tidak dibincangkan.’

item.title: [BM] Kabinet Kekal RON95 Pada RM1.99 — Anwar Kata 'Keputusan Sukar' Sambil Mengelak Reformasi Subsidi Tiga Tahun Berturut-turut
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim mengumumkan pada 11 Mac 2026 — selepas mesyuarat Kabinet — bahawa harga petrol RON95 di bawah mekanisme subsidi bersasar Budi95 akan kekal pada RM1.99 seliter. Beliau menyebutnya ‘keputusan sukar,’ menyatakan bahawa harga pasaran RON95 telah meningkat kira-kira tiga kali ganda akibat konflik AS-Iran yang semakin meningkat.

🔥 Mengapa Ia Penting

Ini bukan kemurahan hati — ia keruntuhan reformasi. Kerajaan Anwar menjanjikan penstrukturan semula subsidi bahan api bersasar sebagai tunjang disiplin fiskal. Mekanisme Budi95, yang dilancarkan sebagai kompromi yang dicairkan, sepatutnya menjadi langkah pertama ke arah memansuhkan subsidi menyeluruh. Sebaliknya, krisis geopolitik memberi kerajaan alasan sempurna untuk menunda reformasi selama-lamanya sambil membelanjakan berbilion untuk subsidi bahan api tanpa sasaran menjelang pilihan raya kilat yang dijangka secara meluas.

item.title: [BM] Kabinet Lulus Terminal Ketiga Pelabuhan Klang Di Pulau Carey — Projek Mega 5,000 Ekar Penuh Cap Jari GLC
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Menteri Pengangkutan Anthony Loke mengumumkan Kabinet telah meluluskan pembangunan Terminal Ketiga Pelabuhan Klang di Pulau Carey — projek mega yang terbengkalai bertahun-tahun. Projek ini melibatkan lebih 5,000 ekar tanah, dengan SD Guthrie (GLC di bawah PNB) dan Perbadanan Kemajuan Negeri Selangor (PKNS) sudah menuntut ribuan hektar tanah dan dasar laut. PKNS diperuntukkan 1,011 hektar tanah dasar laut dan 688 hektar plot Yayasan Selangor diletakkan di bawah pengurusan bersama PKNS. PM Anwar mengeluarkan arahan pada Disember 2025 untuk mempercepatkan projek ini.

item.title: [BM] KPDN Kelam-Kabut Soal Penyeludupan Minyak Lepas Harga Cecah $100 — Armizan Janji Penguatkuasaan Yang Sepatutnya Sudah Lama Ada
item.description:
Said by: Armizan Mohd Ali, Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living (KPDN)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 10–11 Mac, Menteri KPDN Armizan Mohd Ali mengumumkan kementeriannya akan “memperkukuh penguatkuasaan” terhadap penyeludupan minyak dan mempergiatkan operasi Ops Tiris di sempadan negara, selepas harga minyak global melepasi AS$100 setong akibat konflik AS-Israel-Iran yang semakin memuncak. Armizan mengakui jurang yang melebar antara harga minyak bersubsidi Malaysia (RON95 pada RM1.99) dan harga pasaran di negara jiran mewujudkan “risiko tinggi” penyeludupan. Beliau memberitahu orang ramai tiada “keperluan untuk bimbang atau membeli panik” dan mendakwa pelan kontingensi sudah sedia. Secara berasingan, NST melaporkan Anwar melantik Timbalan Perdana Menteri Fadillah Yusof mengetuai jawatankuasa penguatkuasaan khas khusus menyasarkan penyeludupan diesel.

item.title: [BM] Minyak Lepas $100, Selat Hormuz Ditutup, Rakyat Bakar Minyak Pergi Kerja — Anwar Taknak WFH, Taknak Beku Tol, Taknak Kawal Harga Makanan
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Perang Iran-AS telah menolak harga minyak global melepasi $100 setong, menutup Selat Hormuz — laluan hampir 80% minyak Asia — dan menyebabkan FBM KLCI Malaysia menjunam 2.55% dalam satu sesi pada 9 Mac. RON97 naik ke RM3.25, diesel ke RM3.12, dan Anwar sendiri mengakui pada 7 Mac kerajaan hanya mampu mengekalkan RON95 pada RM1.99 untuk ‘satu atau dua bulan lagi.’ Kos pengangkutan melonjak, harga makanan akan menyusul, dan pakar memberi amaran tentang inflasi import yang akan menghentam meja makan rakyat. Tindak balas Anwar setakat ini: tweet solidariti, usul parlimen kecemasan mengutuk Israel, dan Zafrul berkata Malaysia ‘bersedia’ — tanpa menamakan satu pun langkah ekonomi domestik konkrit.

item.title: [BM] Mohamad Hasan Kata Agensi Pelancongan Mesti Bawa Pulang Jemaah Umrah Terperangkap — 'Tak Boleh Serah Kerajaan Sahaja'
item.description:
Said by: Mohamad Hasan, Foreign Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Menteri Luar Negeri Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan, bercakap pada sidang akhbar di Putrajaya pada 11 Mac, mengisytiharkan bahawa syarikat pelancongan dan agensi yang menguruskan pakej umrah mesti bertanggungjawab sepenuhnya membawa pulang jemaah yang terperangkap akibat konflik Asia Barat. Beliau berkata syarikat penerbangan juga mesti menghormati tiket mereka: ‘Jika tiket dengan Malaysia Airlines, MAS mesti bawa pulang. Jika tiket AirAsia, AirAsia mesti buat demikian.’ Beliau menambah tegas: ‘Ia tidak boleh diserahkan kepada kerajaan Malaysia sahaja.’ Ini pada hari yang sama penerbangan pemindahan pertama kerajaan — pesawat sewa Malaysia Airlines A330-300 — mendarat di KLIA dengan hanya 163 rakyat Malaysia dari Arab Saudi, Qatar, Jordan dan Syria.

item.title: [BM] Polis Soal Siasat Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif C4 Antirasuah Bawah Seksyen 124B — Kerajaan Anwar Guna Siasatan 'Komplot Guling' Untuk Gertak Masyarakat Sivil
item.description:
Said by: Bukit Aman (Royal Malaysia Police) / C4 Center (Pushpan Murugiah, CEO)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 10 Mac 2026, Ketua Pegawai Eksekutif Pusat Membanteras Rasuah dan Kronisme (C4) Pushpan Murugiah dipanggil ke Bukit Aman dan disoal siasat selama kira-kira 90 minit di bawah Seksyen 124B Kanun Keseksaan — aktiviti yang memudaratkan demokrasi berparlimen. Soal siasat itu dikaitkan dengan siasatan polis terhadap dakwaan komplot menggulingkan kerajaan. Tetapi soal siasat melangkaui e-mel tersebut. Polis mempersoalkan sumber pembiayaan C4, sama ada organisasi itu menerima arahan untuk mengeluarkan kenyataan, dan — yang mengejutkan — mencabar hak C4 untuk mengulas hal ehwal tadbir urus negara. C4 mengesahkan beberapa pengulas politik dan ahli akademik lain turut dipanggil ke Bukit Aman di bawah siasatan yang sama.

item.title: [BM] Ramanan Ugut 'Tindakan Tegas' Terhadap Kebebasan Bersuara, Kabinet Timbang Undang-Undang 3R Lebih Ketat — Gabungan Yang Janji Mansuh Akta Hasutan
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 Apa Yang Berlaku

Pada 9 Mac 2026, Menteri Sumber Manusia Datuk Seri R. Ramanan mengeluarkan kenyataan memberi amaran bahawa kerajaan akan mengambil “tindakan tegas” terhadap sesiapa yang “sengaja mengancam keamanan negara,” khususnya berkaitan agama, kaum, dan raja (3R). Beliau kata kebebasan bersuara “tidak seharusnya disalahgunakan untuk menghasut atau memecahbelahkan masyarakat.” Dua hari kemudian, pada 11 Mac, Menteri Komunikasi Datuk Fahmi Fadzil mengesahkan Kabinet telah memutuskan “tindakan tegas perlu diambil terhadap isu 3R” dan kerajaan sedang aktif mempertimbangkan pindaan undang-undang sedia ada atau memperkenalkan undang-undang baharu yang lebih ketat. Menjelang 15 Mac, Timbalan Menteri Komunikasi Aaron Ago Dagang berkata semua kementerian akan memainkan peranan menangani isu 3R.

item.title: [BM] Sabah Tolak PH Di Peti Undi — Kini Mustapha Sakmud Kata Dia Suara Mereka Di Putrajaya
item.description:
Said by: Mustapha Sakmud, Sabah PH Chairman / Sabah and Sarawak Affairs Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

Pada 11 Mac 2026, Pengerusi PH Sabah dan Menteri Hal Ehwal Sabah dan Sarawak Mustapha Sakmud memberitahu FMT bahawa PH Sabah akan berperanan sebagai ‘saluran’ untuk memastikan isu negeri disuarakan di peringkat persekutuan. Beliau berkata beliau berhasrat memanfaatkan pelantikan menteri — dibuat pada 15 Februari — untuk membawa kebimbangan rakyat Sabah ke mesyuarat Kabinet.

item.title: Anwar Bans Raya Open Houses for 'Fiscal Discipline' — Days After Announcing RM15 Billion in Cash Handouts and RM500 Bonuses
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced that all government agencies, GLCs, and GLICs are banned from holding Aidilfitri open house celebrations this year — a decision agreed upon in Cabinet that morning. He framed it as a signal of fiscal discipline amid global uncertainty caused by the Middle East conflict. In the same breath, Anwar also announced tighter restrictions on overseas travel for ministers and government officials, saying only pre-scheduled and essential foreign engagements would be approved. A special Cabinet meeting has been called for March 13 to assess the fiscal situation.

item.title: Anwar Says Petroleum Supply 'Secure Until May' — While Strait of Hormuz Burns and Ships Get Attacked
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim held a live-streamed press conference in Putrajaya to address the escalating Middle East energy crisis. He claimed that Malaysia’s petroleum product supplies are “sufficient at least until May 2026,” citing checks with Petronas. He reaffirmed the RM1.99 subsidised RON95 price under Budi Madani, called it a “difficult decision,” and announced a special task force of ministers to review economic impacts daily. He also tasked the Deputy Prime Minister and KPDN with cracking down on fuel smuggling.

item.title: Cabinet Finally Discusses Azam Baki Report — Punts Decision to Chief Secretary, Refuses to Reveal Findings
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister / Cabinet

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced that Cabinet had received and discussed the findings of the special committee — chaired by Attorney General Mohd Dusuki Mokhtar — investigating MACC chief commissioner Azam Baki’s shareholding controversy. Cabinet’s decision: hand the matter to Chief Secretary to the Government Tan Sri Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar to determine “next steps.” Fahmi refused to disclose the report’s contents. When asked directly whether Cabinet discussed the extension of Azam’s contract, Fahmi said: “It was not discussed.” Separately, Cabinet instructed the police, Securities Commission, MACC itself, and the Inland Revenue Board to continue investigating Bloomberg’s “corporate mafia” allegations — including seizing proceeds believed to have criminal elements.

item.title: Cabinet Greenlights Port Klang Third Terminal on Carey Island — A 5,000-Acre Megaproject With GLC Fingerprints All Over It
item.description:
Said by: Anthony Loke, Transport Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Transport Minister Anthony Loke announced that Cabinet has approved the development of Port Klang’s Third Terminal on Carey Island — a megaproject that has been in limbo for years. The project involves over 5,000 acres of land, with SD Guthrie (a GLC under PNB) and the Selangor State Development Corporation (PKNS) already staking claims on thousands of hectares of land and seabed. PKNS was allocated 1,011 hectares of seabed land and a 688-hectare Yayasan Selangor plot was placed under joint PKNS management. PM Anwar issued a directive in December 2025 to accelerate the project, and now Cabinet has formally greenlit it.

item.title: Cabinet Maintains RON95 at RM1.99 — Anwar Calls It a 'Difficult Decision' While Dodging Subsidy Reform for the Third Year Running
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim announced on March 11, 2026 — following a Cabinet meeting — that the price of RON95 petrol under the Budi95 targeted subsidy mechanism will remain at RM1.99 per litre. He called it a “difficult decision,” noting that the market price of RON95 has risen roughly threefold due to the escalating US-Iran conflict disrupting oil markets and threatening Gulf shipping routes. RON97 had already risen to RM3.25, unsubsidised RON95 to RM2.67, and diesel to RM3.12. Anwar framed the decision as a sacrifice for the rakyat.

item.title: Fahmi Announces Special Committee to 'Assess' Economic Impact of US-Iran Conflict — Government's Crisis Playbook Is Another Committee
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

Communications Minister Fahmi Fadzil announced on March 11 that a special committee, led by Petronas chairman Amir Hamzah and including Economy Minister Akmal Nasrullah Mohd Nasir, will evaluate the economic impact of the US-Iran conflict on Malaysia ‘on a daily basis.’ The committee’s findings will be presented at a special Cabinet meeting scheduled for Friday, March 13. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said Malaysia’s petroleum supply is ‘sufficient at least until May 2026,’ even as global oil markets reel from the Strait of Hormuz disruption and retaliatory strikes between Iran, the US, and Israel that began on February 28.

item.title: Fahmi Says Cabinet Orders 'Corporate Mafia' Probe — But Lets MACC Investigate Itself and Ignores RCI Calls
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, Communications Minister Datuk Fahmi Fadzil announced that the Cabinet had ordered enforcement agencies — including the police (PDRM), Securities Commission (SC), Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (MACC), and Inland Revenue Board (LHDN) — to carry out a “detailed probe” into allegations of a “corporate mafia” network operating within MACC. The order came weeks after Bloomberg published a damning investigation titled Who’s Watching Malaysia’s Anti-Corruption Watchdog? alleging that MACC officers had pressured corporate figures in takeover cases. Notably absent from Fahmi’s announcement: any mention of a Royal Commission of Inquiry (RCI), despite growing calls from MPs — including PH’s own Teresa Kok.

item.title: Fahmi Says Cabinet Orders 'Thorough Probe' Into MACC Corporate Mafia — But an RCI? Don't Hold Your Breath
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister and Government Spokesman

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, Communications Minister and government spokesman Fahmi Fadzil told reporters after a Cabinet meeting that enforcement agencies — including the police, Securities Commission, MACC, and Inland Revenue Board — had been instructed to conduct a “thorough” investigation into allegations that certain MACC officials were involved in corporate takeover manoeuvres. Fahmi confirmed the Cabinet had received the special committee’s report on MACC chief Azam Baki’s shareholding scandal but refused to reveal its findings, saying further action would be taken by Chief Secretary Shamsul Azri Abu Bakar. When asked whether Azam’s contract extension was discussed, Fahmi said: “It was not discussed.”

item.title: Fahmi Says Cabinet Wants Stricter 3R Laws — PH Promised to Repeal Restrictive Speech Laws, Now They're Writing New Ones
item.description:
Said by: Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Communications Minister and government spokesperson Fahmi Fadzil announced that Cabinet has decided firm action must be taken on 3R issues — race, religion, and royalty — including on social media. Fahmi said the government is considering amending existing laws or introducing new legislation to close what it describes as loopholes that allow certain individuals to ignore enforcement measures. He said the Attorney General has been directed to act decisively, and that the review would examine gaps in current laws that prevent early enforcement actions such as detentions.

item.title: KPDN Scrambles on Fuel Smuggling After Oil Tops $100 — Armizan Promises Enforcement That Should Have Been in Place for Years
item.description:
Said by: Armizan Mohd Ali, Minister of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living (KPDN)

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 10–11, KPDN Minister Armizan Mohd Ali announced that his ministry would “strengthen enforcement” against fuel smuggling and intensify Ops Tiris operations at national borders, after global oil prices topped US$100 per barrel due to the escalating US-Israel-Iran conflict. Armizan acknowledged that the widening gap between Malaysia’s subsidised fuel prices (RON95 at RM1.99) and market prices in neighbouring countries creates “high risk” of smuggling. He told the public there was “no need for concern or panic buying” and claimed contingency plans were in place. Separately, NST reported that Anwar appointed Deputy Prime Minister Fadillah Yusof to chair a special enforcement committee specifically targeting diesel smuggling (single-source: NST).

item.title: Mohamad Hasan Says Travel Agencies Must Bring Home Stranded Umrah Pilgrims — 'It Cannot Be Left to the Government Alone'
item.description:
Said by: Mohamad Hasan, Foreign Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

Foreign Minister Datuk Seri Mohamad Hasan, speaking at a press conference in Putrajaya on March 11, declared that travel companies and agencies managing umrah packages must take full responsibility for bringing home pilgrims stranded by the West Asia conflict. He said airlines must also honour their tickets: ‘If the ticket is with Malaysia Airlines, MAS must bring them home. If it is an AirAsia ticket, AirAsia must do so.’ He added bluntly: ‘It cannot be left to the Malaysian government alone.’ This came the same day the government’s first evacuation flight — a chartered Malaysia Airlines A330-300 — landed at KLIA with just 163 Malaysians from Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Jordan and Syria, after days of airspace closures and flight disruptions across the Gulf.

item.title: Oil Past $100, Strait of Hormuz Shut, Rakyat Burning Fuel to Commute — Anwar Won't Mandate WFH, Freeze Tolls, Cap Food Prices, or Cut GLC Fat
item.description:
Said by: Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister and Finance Minister

Category: Economy

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

The Iran-US war has pushed global oil past $100 per barrel, effectively shut down the Strait of Hormuz — through which nearly 80% of Asia’s oil transits — and sent Malaysia’s FBM KLCI plunging 2.55% in a single session on March 9. RON97 is up to RM3.25, diesel to RM3.12, and Anwar himself admitted on March 7 that the government can only hold RON95 at RM1.99 for ‘one or two more months.’ Freight costs are surging, food prices are next, and experts from NST to Hong Leong IB are warning of imported inflation hitting the rakyat’s kitchen table. Anwar’s response so far: a strongly worded tweet about solidarity, an emergency parliamentary motion condemning Israel, and Zafrul saying Malaysia is ‘prepared’ — without naming a single concrete domestic measure to protect workers and families from the economic fallout.

item.title: PH Backbenchers Call for Snap Election Dressed Up as 'Reform' — Hold GE16 With All State Polls, Save Money, They Say
item.description:
Said by: Azli Yusof (Amanah-Shah Alam) / Jimmy Puah (PKR-Tebrau)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, two Pakatan Harapan backbenchers — Shah Alam MP Azli Yusof (Amanah) and Tebrau MP Jimmy Puah (PKR) — called for all state assembly elections to be held concurrently with the 16th General Election. Speaking to FMT, both MPs argued that separate elections lead to lower voter turnout, waste public money, and produce state governments with weaker mandates. Azli said separate polls are “unfair to voters, especially those who live far away from where they vote.” Puah called it “simply too tiring for people to come out and vote twice.” Putrajaya spent RM725 million on GE15 in 2022 and a further RM420 million on six subsequent state elections in 2023.

item.title: Police Question C4 Anti-Corruption CEO Under Section 124B — Anwar's Government Uses 'Plot to Topple' Probe to Interrogate Civil Society
item.description:
Said by: Bukit Aman (Royal Malaysia Police) / C4 Center (Pushpan Murugiah, CEO)

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 10, 2026, the Center to Combat Corruption and Cronyism (C4) CEO Pushpan Murugiah was summoned to Bukit Aman and questioned for approximately 90 minutes under Section 124B of the Penal Code — activities detrimental to parliamentary democracy. The questioning was linked to the police investigation into an alleged plot to topple the government, reportedly because Pushpan’s name appeared in an email deemed relevant to the probe. But the interrogation went far beyond that email. Police questioned C4’s sources of funding, whether the organisation had received instructions to issue statements, and — remarkably — challenged C4’s right to comment on matters of national governance. C4 confirmed that several other political commentators and academics had also been summoned to Bukit Aman under the same investigation.

item.title: Ramanan Warns of 'Firm Action' on Free Speech, Cabinet Mulls Stricter 3R Laws — The Coalition That Promised to Repeal the Sedition Act
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Fahmi Fadzil, Communications Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 9, 2026, Human Resources Minister Datuk Seri R. Ramanan issued a statement warning that the government would take “firm action” against anyone who “deliberately threatens national peace,” particularly on matters involving religion, race, and the monarchy (3R). He said freedom of speech “should not be misused to incite or divide society.” Two days later, on March 11, Communications Minister Datuk Fahmi Fadzil confirmed that the Cabinet had decided “firm action must be taken on matters related to 3R” and that the government was actively considering amending existing laws or introducing new, stricter legislation to tackle 3R issues. By March 15, Deputy Communications Minister Aaron Ago Dagang said all ministries would play a role in handling 3R matters.

item.title: Sabah Rejected PH at the Ballot Box — Now Mustapha Sakmud Says He'll Be Their Voice in Putrajaya Anyway
item.description:
Said by: Mustapha Sakmud, Sabah PH Chairman / Sabah and Sarawak Affairs Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-11

📌 What Happened

On March 11, 2026, Sabah PH chairman and Sabah and Sarawak Affairs Minister Mustapha Sakmud told FMT that Sabah PH will serve as a “conduit” to ensure state issues are voiced at the federal level. item.title: Ramanan Claims 'Paid Agents' Are Behind Racial Tensions — Promises Cabinet Crackdown Instead of Addressing Root Causes
item.description:
Said by: R. Ramanan, Human Resources Minister / Aaron Ago Dagang, National Unity Minister

Category: Politics

Date: 2026-03-10

📌 What Happened

Human Resources Minister and PKR Vice-President Datuk Seri R. Ramanan held a special press conference in Putrajaya on March 9 flanked by PKR officials, claiming that “agents of provocation” are being paid to incite racial and religious tensions in Malaysia. He said the matter would be raised at Cabinet on March 11, and that arrests have already been made. National Unity Minister Aaron Ago Dagang echoed the call on March 10, urging police to “take stern action” against anyone disrupting harmony. Neither minister named the alleged provocateurs or their financiers — Ramanan specifically said he would not name them to avoid “making them famous.”
